description: An oil-painting style scene of a dim stage lit from above. A dark-haired head or bun rests against the back of a wooden bar stool, with a black leather jacket draped over the stool. A vintage chrome microphone stands on a stand in front of it, and gold trumpets lean against a dark floor speaker cabinet at right. Cables run across a worn wooden floor. A gilded picture frame is visible at the top left, inside the room. No visible text.
